name: exec-skills
description: An executive-development operating system for product and AI leaders. 20 skills and 16 workflows across 7 plugins that reason across executive doctrine, a private Career Brain, and your Product Brains to diagnose where you stand and what to do next.

plugins.name: exec-core
plugins.description: Foundation for every exec plugin: evidence discipline, the executive prose standard, executive posture diagnosis, the Career Brain protocol, and the source doctrine library. Includes /coach-me, /capture, and /setup-career-brain.

plugins.name: exec-observer
plugins.description: Maintain an honest, longitudinal model of your organizational position: scope, sponsorship, visibility, reputation, readiness, and trajectory. Weekly, monthly, and career-length reviews.

plugins.name: exec-trajectory
plugins.description: Close the gap to the next level and grow scope legitimately: level models, readiness and promotion evidence, scope expansion, and enterprise thinking.

plugins.name: exec-influence
plugins.description: Build the trust, sponsorship, and influence larger scope requires: executive trust, managing up, sponsorship, and organizational politics with an ethical line.

plugins.name: exec-communication
plugins.description: Communicate at the right altitude with ownership and judgment: executive updates, recommendations, escalations, decision memos, board material, and presence in consequential meetings.

plugins.name: exec-leadership
plugins.description: Multiply output through others and systems: managerial leverage, delegation, operating cadence, time allocation, decision rights, and decision quality.

plugins.name: exec-product-leadership
plugins.description: Lead product capability at organizational level, and operate as the credible AI product executive: strategic context, empowered teams, AI economics, evaluation as governance, and AI risk.
